meta.title: Aikido Mariánské Lázně – BUDO CLUB
meta.description: Aikido club in Mariánské Lázně. Aikido training for children, teens and adults. Tuesdays and Fridays at BUDO CLUB. First 3 training sessions free.

hero.subtitle: AIKIDO MARIÁNSKÉ LÁZNĚ
hero.motto: The idea behind practicing aikido is to develop both body and mind and to be able to defend yourself.

cta.title: Come try a training session
cta.text: All you need is sweatpants and a long-sleeve shirt. Training is done barefoot. No previous experience is required.

event.title: Invitation
event.tagline: A fresh start on the tatami
event.intro: Summer is over, the holiday sandals are tucked away and the tatami opens again. The first September training is traditionally the moment we meet back in the dojo after the break – and it is also the perfect time for anyone who wants to start with aikido.
event.outro: No previous experience is required. All you need is sweatpants, a long-sleeve shirt and the willingness to try something new. We train barefoot. Come on Friday, September 4 at 17:30 – we will be looking forward to meeting you.

about.title: The path of harmony
about.p1: Aikido is one of the youngest martial arts in the world. Its philosophy emphasizes harmony rather than destruction. It is a system of non-resistance that enables effective self-defense without destructive techniques.
about.p2: Aikido is a martial system that allows you to control an opponent without causing harm. It is one of the most humane martial arts, while also requiring great control of one's own ego and psyche.
